{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=48|time=2 hours|difficulty=4}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]
==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
*675 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1.49 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] / 5½ sticks) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], plus extra for greasing
*675 g (1.49 lb / 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) superfine [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
*12 medium or 10 large (about 500 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*675 g (1.49 lb / 5 cups) [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] each of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple [[Cookbook:Food Coloring|food colourings]]
===Icing===
*500 g (1.1 lb / 4 sticks) unsalted butter
*1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] (2.2 lb / 8 cups) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
*3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*1 tbsp vanilla extract
*[[Cookbook:Sprinkles|Sprinkles]] (eg. hundreds and thousands) (optional)
==Procedure==

====== Make cake ======
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F}}. Grease and [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|line]] six {{Convert|20|cm|in|abbr=on|adj=on}} round [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tins]].
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the eggs, two at a time.
#Combine the flour and baking powder. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] this dry mixture into the batter.
#Divide the mixture into 6 separate bowls.
#Add the red food colouring, one drop at a time, to the mixture in one bowl and stir in until the mixture reached the desired colour.
#Repeat step 6, using orange, yellow, green, blue and purple food colourings.
#Spread the red mixture in one of cake tin. Repeat with other colours.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 25 minutes, in batches of two cakes, until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] inserted comes out clean.
#Transfer the cakes to a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and leave to cool. Unmold cakes.

====== Make icing ======
#For the icing, beat the butter in a mixing bowl until soft.
#Add half of the icing sugar, 1 cup at a time, and beat in.
#Beat in the milk and vanilla extract.
#Add the rest of icing sugar, 1 cup at a time, and beat in.

====== Assemble cake ======
#Spread one-eighth of the icing onto the purple cake. Top with blue cake layer, and press gently.
#Repeat the frosting and cake layering in rainbow order, finishing with the red layer.
#Spread the rest of icing all over the cake.
#If you like, sprinkle the cake with sprinkles.
#Enjoy!

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Gel food coloring is better than dilute liquid coloring. Using more concentrated coloring will result in more vibrant colors.
* Mixing the food coloring into the cake batter after the flour is added can make the cake tough due to the additional stirring needed. Be careful to only mix as much as necessary.
